scope: Fixed compiled-global constant(...$a) with one source-authenticated ordinary variable-expression unpack. The current CV holds the packed array, whose only entry is an ALIAS reference cell at positional key 0 or named key name. The live cell, captured DIRECT pack item and normalized sent argument hold the exact HALT name. No owner, selection, fallback or later argument; partial dynamic-source behavior.
engine_route: Zend/zend_compile.c emits SEND_UNPACK. Zend/zend_vm_def.h::ZEND_SEND_UNPACK copies and dereferences a by-value constant argument. ext/standard/basic_functions.c::PHP_FUNCTION(constant) calls zend_get_constant_ex; Zend/zend_constants.c::zend_get_halt_offset_constant uses the executed filename.
mechanism: At a genuine CONFIG_INVOKE, one raw NExprVariable unpack must lead through ENV/STORE to the same allocated PARRAY as the source-valid pack. Its singleton ALIAS cell must be a live allocated REFCELL with a defined exact string; current capture yields the same DIRECT entry and SENT. The existing filename-local declaration journal returns an offset or the ordinary absent-registration Error. The array retains the cell if the original variable name moves.
